facts.fact: 她从戛然而止的广州之行回到香港，已经待了一星期。
facts.anchor: Kiamling had been back in Hong Kong for a week after the abruptly curtailed Canton incident

facts.fact: 最近这几天尤其糟，是彻头彻尾的灾难。
facts.anchor: The last few days in particular had been an unmitigated disaster.

facts.fact: Archie 委婉地问她要不要谈谈这件事。
facts.anchor: “Would you like to talk about it, Miss Kim?”

facts.fact: 他们到的时候，渔船正驶进维多利亚港。
facts.anchor: The fishing boats had been pulling into Hong Kong’s Victoria Harbour

facts.fact: 华人区新遭袭的是裁缝学徒、一对幽会的情人、太平山街的一名妓女。
facts.anchor: A tailor’s apprentice, a pair of lovers out on a tryst, and one of the courtesans from Tai Ping Shan Street.

facts.fact: 受害者的气脉堵得像焦油。
facts.anchor: their qi gummed up like tar

facts.fact: 她替他们疏通经络，嘱咐喝补汤、卧床休息。
facts.anchor: Kiamling unblocked their meridian lines, advised on revitalising soups and bed rest.

facts.fact: 少了 Barrister Ng，本地华人就没有人替他们说话。
facts.anchor: without Barrister Ng’s presence, there was no voice for the local Chinese population

facts.fact: 她提出的宵禁遭到轻蔑对待。
facts.anchor: The proposed curfew was met with contempt

facts.fact: 她把龙虾赶错了方向，渔夫冲她喊“你手太多了”。
facts.anchor: “You got too many hands!” the fisherman yelled to her

facts.fact: 渔妇让她管好“你的鬼佬”，她回答“他不是我的鬼佬”。
facts.anchor: “He’s not my gweilo,” Kiamling responded.

facts.fact: Archie 用还过得去的广东话插话：我是我自己的主人。
facts.anchor: “I am my own man,” Archie interjected in passable Cantonese

facts.fact: 她让他去点一份早饭。
facts.anchor: “Order us some breakfast.”

facts.fact: 摊主们围上来扯他的袖子，怪他不把生意给自己。
facts.anchor: Soon all the stallholders had accosted him

facts.fact: 他是她那些麻烦的一味宣泄。
facts.anchor: Archie was a cathartic distraction to her own problems.

facts.fact: 他用广东话大声宣布“我饿了”，好让她听见。
facts.anchor: “I am hungry,” he declared in Cantonese, loud enough for her to hear.

facts.fact: 他从她头上拈下东西，说头发里同时有蛋壳和叶子，连她也算少见。
facts.anchor: It is unusual, even for you, to have both eggshells and leaves in your hair.

facts.fact: 她说家谱能一路追到钟馗的家系。
facts.anchor: all the way to the family of Chung Kwai, King of Ghosts

facts.fact: 他说这不叫固执，叫勇气。
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t call that stubborn. I’d call it courageous.

facts.fact: 她承认他也一点一点改变了她。
facts.anchor: Little by little he had started to change her too.
